detail.title: Robustness of Physical Records Across Independent Observers
detail.summary: Physical record robustness is not a primitive property but an emergent phenomenon. Using Spectrum Broadcast Structures (SBS) and quantum Darwinism frameworks, we show that objective character arises when environmental interaction encodes a system's state redundantly, allowing multiple observers to extract consistent information without disrupting the source.
detail.reason: Synthesized foundational evidence comparing quantum Darwinism and Spectrum Broadcast Structures to establish robustness criteria.
